title: A year of Gemini progress + what comes next — Logan Kilpatrick, Google DeepMind
talk_summary: A Google DeepMind developer-relations keynote recapping a year of Gemini progress and teasing upcoming models, the Gemini app, and developer platform features. It is almost entirely product announcements and organizational narrative with no engineering mechanisms or measured results.

takeaways.technique: Consolidate scattered teams into one model+product org
takeaways.what_they_do: Google merged separate AI research teams into DeepMind, then folded product teams in so model creators and product builders share one org and ship together.
takeaways.evidence_quote: bringing the product teams into DeepMind. So now DeepMind creates the models, does the research um but then also builds products

takeaways.what_they_do: Speaker states current attention-based paradigm cannot scale to infinite context and expects new innovations; no mechanism given.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the current model paradigm doesn't work for infinite context. I think it's just like impossible to scale up. Attention doesn't work that way.
